incident_time: 16:36 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 The Stewards have received a request from Uralkali Haas F1 Team to allow car 47 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 47, Mick Schumacher, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Decision Car 47 Failure To Set A Time In Q1
